statements.t: “We entered 2026 with a clear plan to deliver multiple important clinical and operational milestones this year and we have made significant progress executing against that plan.

The oral presentation will be delivered by our ELIMINATE-B lead investigator, Man Fung Yuen, MD, Ph.D., Chair Professor of The University of Hong Kong and the Chief of the Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, Queen Mary Hospital,” said Michael Amoroso, Chief Executive Officer of Precision BioSciences.
“We remain on track to deliver data updates from both programs by year end, supported by a financial position that provides expected runway through 2028 and through key clinical inflection points.”

The Company expects that existing cash and cash equivalents, continued fiscal and operating discipline, and availability of Precision’s at-the-market facility will fund the Company’s cash runway through 2028.

risks.t: our ability to procure sufficient funding to advance our programs
our operating expenses and our ability to predict what those expenses will be
the progression and success of our programs and product candidates in which we expend our resources
our limited ability or inability to assess the safety and efficacy of our product candidates
the risk that other genome-editing technologies may provide significant advantages over our ARCUS technology
our dependence on our ARCUS technology
public perception about genome editing technology and its applications
competition in the genome editing, biopharmaceutical, and biotechnology fields
our or our collaborators’ or other licensees’ ability to identify, develop and commercialize product candidates
the U.S. and foreign regulatory landscape applicable to our and our collaborators’ or other licensees’ development of product candidates
our or our collaborators’ or other licensees’ ability to advance product candidates into, and successfully design, implement and complete, clinical trials
potential manufacturing problems associated with the development or commercialization of any of our product
